_doc: Film render options every render request carries into its job (render-request.sh -> job.fps, job.blur; tools/experience/RENDER-QUEUE.md). FILM_FPS: output frame rate (30, 60, or 120; included in chapter cache keys when != 30). FILM_BLUR: render-cut.cjs --blur, sub-frames per film frame; the last half are blended (180-degree shutter) and only those are baked (render-shutter.cjs): e.g. 8 at 30 fps (4 taps), 4 at 60 fps (2 taps), 1 at 120 fps. Changing FILM_BLUR alone still needs a render-epoch bump.
